title: Mother and Son Wading in Ocean Waves, 1950s Beach B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th century black-and-white snapshot featuring a woman and a young boy holding hands as they dip their feet into the rolling ocean surf. The boy sports cool sunglasses, a white sleeveless tank, and dark shorts, while the woman wears a dark dress and glasses. The print features classic deckled edges and minor vintage light exposure on the left side.
